{{Power Infobox|Slippery|2}}
'''Inklet''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}. They always appear in groups of three and start with one stack of {{BD2|Slippery}} each.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Inklet}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Jab
|Intent = Attack1
|Effect = Deals (3;{{Asc2|9|4}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Whirlwind
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (2;{{Asc2|9|3}}) damage ×3.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Piercing Gaze
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (10;{{Asc2|9|11}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The two outer Inklets open with {{Int2|Inklet|Jab}}. The middle Inklet always opens with {{Int2|Inklet|Whirlwind}}.

Alternates between {{Int2|Inklet|Jab}} and a random choice (equal chance) between {{Int2|Inklet|Piercing Gaze}} or {{Int2|Inklet|Whirlwind}}.

== Trivia ==
* One of {{M2|Vantom}}'s death messages implies that Inklets are creatures transformed into monsters by Vantom.

{{Clear}}
